workUnitId.description: Client-supplied unique identifier for this work unit.

cpt.description: This work unit's Critical Pull Time — drives release priority (earliest CPT first).

reference.description: An external reference this work unit corresponds to (e.g. an order line).

sku.description: OPTIONAL inventory SKU this order line corresponds to, if known. When set, ReleaseNextWork's outbound WorkReleased event carries derived hazmat-capability/fragile hints looked up once from inventory-storage's product classification at release time (see ADR-0009). Omit — or send null, which is treated exactly like omitted — when the SKU is not known to the caller.

giftWrap.description: OPTIONAL. Whether the requester asked the warehouse to produce a gift package for this work unit, stated at enqueue time. This is a caller-stated WorkReleased characteristic, not a product attribute — unlike `sku`, it is never looked up from another service (see ADR-0010). Omit — or send null, which is treated as not requested — when gift wrap was not asked for.

lineNo.description: OPTIONAL. The 1-based order line this work unit is for, stored on the work unit and carried as `line_no` on its `WorkReleased` event (ADR-0036). It never changes `workUnitId` — the order-allocation consumer's `<order>-line-<n>` ids stay as they are. Omit — or send null, which is treated exactly like omitted — when the line is not known; `0`, negative values and values above `2147483647` (the 32-bit column limit) are rejected with `400` (`invalid-line-no`).

quantity.description: OPTIONAL (ADR-0045). Quantity in EACHES; with `pickUnit` or `fromBin` it is required and makes the unit a pack-aware pick (`CASE_PICK` / `EACH_PICK`). Needs `sku`; below 1 is `400 invalid-pick-plan`.

pickUnit.description: OPTIONAL (ADR-0045), default `EACH` for a pick. `CASE` needs an active CASE pack level and a whole number of cases (otherwise `422`). Any other value is `400 unknown-pick-unit`.

fromBin.description: OPTIONAL (ADR-0045). Source bin of the pick.

allOf.description: The sealed-case break of a `BREAK_CASE` work unit (ADR-0045).

looseBin.description: The bin the loose eaches go to.

pickTaskId.description: The pick task the break serves.

allOf.title: CaseBreak

caseBreak.description: OPTIONAL (ADR-0045). Makes the unit a `BREAK_CASE`; needs `sku` and excludes `quantity`, `pickUnit` and `fromBin` (otherwise `400 invalid-case-break`).

allOf.description: A sealed-case break (`caseBreak`) excludes the pick fields.
A pick plan or a case break needs a non-blank `sku` (null counts as absent).
